facts.text: Skyline Acres sits 11 miles north of downtown Cincinnati, a short drive into the heart of Ohio’s urban core.
The name “Skyline Acres” literally means a developed area of land offering a notable view of the horizon, a common naming trend for newer suburban developments.
The region around Skyline Acres has seen major historical moments, from the founding of Cincinnati to the construction of the Erie Canal and the establishment of Wright‑Patterson Air Force Base.
Seasonal weather in Skyline Acres swings from warm, humid summers to cold, snowy winters, making spring and autumn the most pleasant times to explore the area.
Transportation in Skyline Acres relies mainly on personal vehicles, with regional road networks linking the suburb to larger Ohio hubs.
